summary: Kaniksu National Forest hike-in lookout near Porthill, Idaho; sources disagree on a 1934 tower vs a 1937 cabin; destroyed in the 1950s, now listed as gone.

facts.design: Sources disagree: firelookout.com gives a 20-foot L-4 tower dated 1934; idahofirelookouts.com lists a small cabin in 1937
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list marks it as gone, type Ground; no source describes remains on the site

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site on idahofirelookouts.com; no trail described

events.note: firelookout.com: 20-foot L-4 tower; idahofirelookouts.com gives a different first structure (see 1937)
idahofirelookouts.com: small cabin; conflicts with the 1934 tower date on firelookout.com
Howard Green, listed as lookout in 1934; earliest documented staffing
Destroyed in the 1950s; sources give only the decade, no single year

evidence.quote: Ed Johnson ( Forest Fire Lookout Page )

evidence.supports: destroyed in the 1950s; Howard Green 1934; Ed Johnson 1935-1936
evidence.quote: 1934: 20' L-4 tower. Destroyed 1950s. Known lookout personnel: 1934: Howard Green; 1935-1936: Ed Johnson.

evidence.supports: about seven miles southwest of Porthill

corrections.proposed: destroyed in the 1950s (decade only; no exact year given)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources disagree: 1934 20-foot L-4 tower (firelookout.com) vs 1937 small cabin (idahofirelookouts.com). The story reports both and does not choose; the 1934 date matches the staff list.

notes_for_editor: Only two lookout-history pages plus the FFLA list; firetower.org was unreachable (connection reset) when tried. FFLA coordinates 48.92300, -116.59808 differ from the record's 48.95976, -116.5438 by roughly 4 km; not resolved here. The record's lat/lon were left unchanged. Built date conflict (1934 tower vs 1937 cabin) is reported in the story rather than chosen. Destruction year is only the 1950s.
